cr_data.provenance: Artist; purchased by Caroline Marmon Fesler, Indianapolis, Indiana; by descent to Anne Marmon Greenleaf, Indianapolis, Indiana, in 1960; given to the Indianapolis Museum of Art, in 1977. (Source: Indianapolis Museum of Art website, 2025)
remarks_1999: Reproduced in *Magazine of Art* (March 1944); as *Pelvis with the Distance* in *New York Times* (May 1946). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Pelvis with Distance

description: The bright white form of an animal's pelvis bone dominates the composition. A landscape featuring flat, yellow earth dotted with green bushes and blue mountains rising beyond stretches out in the background. A light blue, cloudless sky hovers above.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Indianapolis Museum of Art.
title: Pelvis with Distance
